visual_logic.surface_detail: Classic 'Navy Blue' and 'Silver' countershading, mapping cleanly and evenly across the sleek, dolphin-like horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the large, expressive eye and the distinctive vertical tail fluke oriented parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.environment: Cold, clear Early Jurassic coastal waters. The swimming ammonites and airborne water droplets are restricted entirely to distant background layers to keep the silhouette line completely unobstructed.

pose: The primitive ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic mid-air breaching pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path just beneath or at the water line, stretching its dolphin-like snout, streamlined body, flippers, and vertical tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
